text:
cam: Quick follow-up to the retry-sampling RFC. Thinking of moving the lightweight retry-decision (sample vs immediate retry) into the edge and encoding the outcome for runtime / telemetry. Sketch below.

jess: Quick summary of goals? reduce wasted duplicate work, better SLO attribution?

cam: Exactly. Goals: 1) avoid backend work when a retry is unlikely to improve user-observed quality, 2) attribute retries/initial attempts to a single user request in telemetry, 3) keep cancellation/side-effect semantics explicit so we don't double-write.

mike: How is this different from our current X-Retry-Id / X-Retry-Reason headers?

cam: Current headers are passive. New plan: edge evaluates a tiny decision rule and emits a decision header. Minimal initial API: X-Retry-Group: <uuid>, X-Retry-Decision: sampled|control|deferred, X-Idempotency-State: safe|unsafe|unknown. Edge also emits metric labels so we can slice outcomes by decision.

olga: That pushes more logic into the edge. CPU/complexity concerns — prefer simple rule engine vs full cost-model machine.

cam: Agreed. Implementation path: start with deterministic rule set (ruleset delivered as small config map). Example rules: if error==timeout && latency>800ms && seq_len<512 -> mark sampled; if error==429 && retries_left>0 -> control; else defer. If iteration shows value, we can explore a lightweight expected-value cost model.

jess: Observability requirements: counters retry_decision{sampled,control,deferred}, outcome_by_decision (success-after-retry, fail-after-deferred, duplicate-sideeffect), and traces joining initial+retry. Need P99 by decision bucket.

cam: Plan: attach X-Retry-Group header (uuid) to link attempts. Also set trace tag retry.group on spans created by edge and runtime. Edge emits a metric `edge.retry_decision` with labels: reason, decision, route. Runtime emits `runtime.retry_outcome` with label `retry_group`. We'll also emit a small audit log event when decision==deferred and the request later triggers a server-side fallback.

mike: Backends inspect idempotency; we must not blindly retry unsafe endpoints. How do we enforce that?

cam: Edge will consult endpoint metadata: if X-Idempotency-State==unsafe, edge will never trigger automatic immediate retries — only deferred (i.e., record the group and let runtime decide fallback). We'll maintain an idempotency policy store (small table) used by edge and runtime.

anil: Rollout and safety?

cam: Canary: 5% traffic in us-west1 for 24h. Monitor: duplicate-sideeffect.rate, error rate per route, P95/P99 latency, and the metrics jess listed. Blockers: any sign of >0.01% duplicate side-effects or P99 latency regressing >5%.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: config/retry-sample-v1 -> 5% (us-west1)

sre-bot: Watching. Added temporary alerts: duplicate-sideeffect.rate > 0.01% and p99_latency_increase > 5%.

jess: Edge <-> runtime contract: we must update the HTTP contract doc and SDKs so customers (and internal SDKs) can opt-out or declare idempotency. @kai can you pick this up?

kai: Yep. I'll add SDK helper for X-Idempotency-State and a migration note for explicit idempotency declarations.

cam: Example header payload we propose now (single-line for clarity):

```
X-Retry-Group: 3f2e6a8b-9f34-4d2a-8c11-0b4a7f2d1a9c
X-Retry-Decision: sampled
X-Idempotency-State: safe
X-Retry-Mode: default|legacy
```

cam: Notes on tradeoffs: if edge defers a retry and runtime lacks budget, user gets failure. Alternative was immediate edge fallback to a cheaper model variant (e.g., small-quantized) — higher complexity but improves availability. Suggest we start small (defer + telemetry) and evaluate.

olga: +1 start small. Keep the rule set tiny and config-driven.

mike: Can we add an escape hatch header to force legacy behavior for critical partners? e.g., X-Retry-Mode: legacy -> bypass decision logic.

cam: Yes, we'll support X-Retry-Mode: legacy|force|default as an override. Documented and off by default.

jess: Also need to consider billing attribution: deferred retries that later trigger server-side fallback should attribute cost to same request. Add a billing label `retry_group` to invoice logs.

cam: Agreed — runtime will include retry_group in billing records.

anil: Anything else for rollout checklist?

cam: Add: 1) update HTTP contract doc, 2) implement edge ruleset and metric emission, 3) runtime honor deferred header + add fallback hook, 4) devex SDK changes, 5) canary + SRE alerting, 6) post-canary impact review.

mike: LGTM. When do we sync RFC follow-up doc?

cam: I'll update the RFC with decisions and timeline by EOD. @jess will own the telem dashboards.

jess: I'll create dashboards for decision buckets + outcome_by_decision and add runbook notes.

cam: Thanks all. Small PR incoming for the edge rules config and metric names.

olga: :thumbsup:

mike: :+1:

sre-bot: Canary watching complete: no alerts fired in first 6h. Continuing monitoring.

cam: Cheers — will post the RFC update when PRs land.
